description.value: Heritage Asian Eatery's Lonsdale Quay outpost is a quick-serve counter-service spot in North Vancouver's busy waterfront public market, part of a small BC multi-location chain. The menu celebrates classic Chinese comfort food — fried rice, chow mein, orange chicken, sweet and sour pork, and an in-house BBQ case offering char siu, roast duck, soy chicken, and roast pork alongside handcrafted dim sum. Its location inside Lonsdale Quay Market places it steps from the SeaBus terminal and the North Shore waterfront cycling routes.
